description: Administrative interface for managing organizational hierarchy and partner tree structure. Allows viewing, editing, and organizing partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format.

pages.name: PartnerTreeComponent
pages.description: This page provides the administrative interface for managing your organization's hierarchy and partner tree structure. You can view, edit, and organize partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format, allowing for clear visualization and management of your business relationships.

buttons.label: New Partner Level
buttons.description: This button opens a dialog to create a new organizational node, such as a category or group, within the partner hierarchy tree. Use this to expand your organizational structure.
when_to_use: When you need to add a new category or group to your partner hierarchy.
When you are setting up a new division or segment within your organization's structure.
When you want to define a new level for partner classification.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, remember that the main area displays your organizational structure as a tree. To add a new level, click the 'New Partner Level' button. To explore different parts of the hierarchy, use the expand/collapse arrows next to each node. To modify an existing partner level, simply click on its row in the tree.
common_tasks: Creating partner levels: Click the 'New Partner Level' button located at the top of the page to open the creation dialog and define a new organizational node.
Editing partner structure: Click on any existing node (row) within the tree view to open its details for modification. Make your changes and save.
Managing hierarchy: Utilize the drag-and-drop functionality (if enabled) to reorder or nest partner levels, or use the edit function to assign parent/child relationships.
Viewing organizational structure: Click the expand (arrow pointing right) or collapse (arrow pointing down) icons next to each node to reveal or hide its sub-levels.
Administrative management: Use this page to configure and maintain the relationships and reporting structures between different partner categories and groups.
